labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: patients must have R/R AML or MDS
HIV-infected patients on effective anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months are eligible

labels.note: Requires relapsed/refractory AML; patient is in remission after aza/ven with only molecular MRD, not relapsed or refractory.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Patients must have relapsed after or be refractory to at least one course of an intensive chemotherapy regimen
Hypomethylating agents such as azacitidine or decitabine are allowed as a prior therapy, but are not considered an intensive chemotherapy regimen.

labels.note: Patient never had intensive chemo and is in remission; not relapsed/refractory to intensive regimen.

evidence.quote: R/R AML, as defined by standardized criteria
Participant must have CLL or SLL (WHO criteria).

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Participants must have newly diagnosed, untreated confirmed acute myeloid leukemia
Participants must not have received a hypomethylating agent, any BCL-2 inhibitors including venetoclax

labels.note: Requires untreated AML; patient already received azacitidine + venetoclax.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Previously untreated, de novo acute myeloid leukemia
Prior therapy for AML except for hydroxyurea and leukapheresis to control blood counts

labels.note: Untreated AML only and NPM1-mutated AML excluded; patient is NPM1+ and treated.

labels.label: not_relevant

evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed participants with either CLL or SLL or B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia or lymphoma (ALL)

labels.note: CD19 CAR-T for CLL/ALL; patient has AML.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed or relapsed/refractory AML who have received either intensive induction chemotherapy or at least 2 cycles of a non-intensive options such as hypomethylating agent and venetoclax
Patients with AML must have persistent or recurrent MRD positivity
Residual blasts must be positive for CD33 expression at any level
Known human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) with detectable viral load

labels.note: MRD+ AML after 4 cycles aza/ven with undetectable HIV fits; CD33 status and LVEF (heart history) unknown.
